55428-the-steam-engine-familiarly-explai.title: The Steam Engine Familiarly Explained And Illustrated With A
55428-the-steam-engine-familiarly-explai.creator: Unknown
55428-the-steam-engine-familiarly-explai.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This volume should more properly be called a new work than a new edition of the former one. In fact the book has been almost rewritten. The change which has taken place, even in the short period which has elapsed since the publication of the first edition, in the relation of the steam engine to the useful arts, has been so considerable as to render this inevitable.

arxiv-2112-13320.title: Budget Sensitive Reannotation of Noisy Relation Classification Data Using Label Hierarchy
arxiv-2112-13320.creator: Akshay Parekh, Ashish Anand, Amit Awekar
arxiv-2112-13320.description: Abstract Large crowd-sourced datasets are often noisy and relation classification (RC) datasets are no exception. Reannotating the entire dataset is one probable solution however it is not always viable due to time and budget constraints. This paper addresses the problem of efficient reannotation of a large noisy dataset for the RC.

arxiv-2203-15374.title: A detailed study on novel metamaterial absorber at WR3 band
arxiv-2203-15374.creator: Sarvesh Gharat, Shriganesh Prabhu
arxiv-2203-15374.description: Abstract Frequency band of 30 to 300 GHz, which is termed as mm wave band offers 100 times bandwidth as compared to sub 6 GHz band. In this study, we propose a novel design which acts as a near unity absorber at 258 GHz or 0.258 THz in Y polarisation and 292 GHz or 0.292 THz in X polarisation.

MT was partially supported by the FCT (Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia) project 2022.07167.PTDC. The authors thank the referee for useful
arxiv-2204-05008.creator: Natalia Jurga, Mike Todd
arxiv-2204-05008.description: Abstract . We introduce the notion of cover time to dynamical systems. This quantifies the rate at which orbits become dense in the state space and can be viewed as a global, rather than the more standard local, notion of recurrence for a system.

arxiv-2208-02801.title: Transformers as Meta-Learners for Implicit Neural Representations
arxiv-2208-02801.creator: Yinbo Chen, Xiaolong Wang
arxiv-2208-02801.description: Abstract Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged and shown their benefits over discrete representations in recent years. However, fitting an INR to the given observations usually requires optimization with gradient descent from scratch, which is inefficient and does not generalize well with sparse observations.

arxiv-2309-14806.title: 3D printed realistic finger vein phantoms
arxiv-2309-14806.creator: 1 st Luuk Spreeuwers, 2 nd Rasmus van der Grift, 3 rd Pesigrihastamadya Normakristagaluh
arxiv-2309-14806.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by 1 st Luuk Spreeuwers, 2 nd Rasmus van der Grift, 3 rd Pesigrihastamadya Normakristagaluh. Finger vein pattern recognition is an emerging biometric with a good resistance to presentation attacks and low error rates. One problem is that it is hard to obtain ground truth finger vein patterns from live fingers.

arxiv-2312-10253.title: Catwalk: A Unified Language Model Evaluation Framework for Many Datasets
arxiv-2312-10253.creator: Dirk Groeneveld, Anas Awadalla, Iz Beltagy, Akshita Bhagia, Ian Magnusson, Hao Peng, Oyvind Tafjord, Pete Walsh, Kyle Richardson, Jesse Dodge
arxiv-2312-10253.description: Abstract The success of large language models has shifted the evaluation paradigms in natural language processing (NLP). The community’s interest has drifted towards comparing NLP models across many tasks, domains, and datasets, often at an extreme scale. This imposes new engineering challenges: efforts in constructing datasets and models have been fragmented, and their formats and interfaces are incompatible.

arxiv-2403-13253.title: Document Author Classification Using Parsed Language Structure
arxiv-2403-13253.creator: Todd K. Moon, Jacob H. Gunther
arxiv-2403-13253.description: Abstract Over the years there has been ongoing interest in detecting authorship of a text based on statistical properties of the text, such as by using occurrence rates of noncontextual words. In previous work, these techniques have been used, for example, to determine authorship of all of The Federalist Papers .

arxiv-2407-16755.title: The stellar distribution in ultra-faint dwarf galaxies suggests deviations from the collision-less cold dark matter paradigm Facilities: HST (WFC – WFC3) PyAbel ( Hickstein et al. 2019 ) , Scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , emcee ( Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 ) .
arxiv-2407-16755.creator: Jorge Sánchez Almeida, Ignacio Trujillo, Angel R. Plastino
arxiv-2407-16755.description: Abstract Unraveling the nature of dark matter (DM) stands as a primary objective in modern physics. Here we present evidence suggesting deviations from the collisionless Cold DM (CDM) paradigm. It arises from the radial distribution of stars in six Ultra Faint Dwarf (UFD) galaxies measured with the Hubble Space Telescope (HST).

arxiv-2511-22662.title: Difficulties with Evaluating a Deception Detector for AIs
arxiv-2511-22662.creator: Lewis Smith, Bilal Chughtai, Neel Nanda
arxiv-2511-22662.description: Abstract Building reliable deception detectors for AI systems – methods that could predict when an AI system is being strategically deceptive without necessarily requiring behavioural evidence – would be valuable in mitigating risks from advanced AI systems. But evaluating the reliability and efficacy of a proposed deception detector requires examples that we can confidently label as either deceptive or honest.

arxiv-2602-03466.title: Quantum circuit generation via test-time learning with large language models
arxiv-2602-03466.creator: Adriano Macarone-Palmieri, Rosario Lo Franco
arxiv-2602-03466.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) can generate structured artifacts, but turning them into dependable optimizers for scientific design requires closed-loop refinement under black-box evaluation. We formulate quantum circuits synthesis as a test-time optimization problem in which an LLM proposes edits to a fixed-length gate list and an external simulator scores the resulting state using the Meyer-Wallach (MW) global entanglement measure.

pmc-11492793.title: Perceptions of the 2D short animated videos for literacy against chronic diseases among adults with diabetes and/or hypertension: a qualitative study in primary care clinics
pmc-11492793.creator: Panan Pichayapinyo, Malinee Sompopcharoen, Weena Thiangtham, Jutatip Sillabutra, Phenchan Meekaew, Benyada Bureerat, Armote Somboonkaew
pmc-11492793.description: BackgroundAnimation has promise for teaching complex health content through smartphone applications. However, smartphones have had limited use in Thailand for health literacy improvement among adults with chronic diseases. This study aims to explore the perceptions of adults with diabetes and/or hypertension resulting from 2D short animated videos for literacy against chronic disease that are available via smartphones.

pmc-11554932.title: Lipoteichoic Acid from Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG as a Novel Intracanal Medicament Targeting Enterococcus faecalis Biofilm Formation
pmc-11554932.creator: Ji-Young Yoon, Somin Park, Dongwook Lee, Ok-Jin Park, WooCheol Lee, Seung Hyun Han

Recently, lipoteichoic acid (LTA) of family Lactobacillaceae has been shown to have anti-biofilm effects against various oral pathogens. Preliminary experiments showed that LTA purified from Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG (Lgg.LTA) was the most effective against E.

pmc-12363272.title: Strategies and delivery systems for cell-based therapy in autoimmunity
pmc-12363272.creator: Matteo Puccetti, Claudio Costantini, Aurélie Schoubben, Stefano Giovagnoli, Maurizio Ricci
pmc-12363272.description: This review article explores the potential of engineering antigen-presenting cells (APCs) for the immunotherapy of autoimmune diseases. It discusses various strategies for modifying APCs to induce antigen-specific tolerance, thereby mitigating autoimmune responses. The review covers recent advancements in APC engineering techniques, including genetic modification and nanoparticle-based approaches, and evaluates their efficacy in preclinical models and clinical trials.

pmc-13200912.title: Hepatic Amyloid Light-Chain Amyloidosis Incidentally Diagnosed via Endoscopic Ultrasound-Guided Liver Biopsy
pmc-13200912.creator: Yuta Tsujiguchi, Tsuyoshi Suda, Tatsuya Imi, Miyabi Miura, Kiichiro Kaji, Kuniaki Arai, Kenichi Harada, Shuichi Terasaki
pmc-13200912.description: Hepatic amyloid light-chain (AL) amyloidosis is characterized by amyloid protein deposition in the liver, requiring biopsy for diagnosis. We report a 71-year-old man with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/Waldenström macroglobulinemia presenting with hepatomegaly and elevated enzymes. Imaging revealed no masses. The patient was diagnosed with hepatic AL amyloidosis through repeat endoscopic ultrasound-guided liver biopsy (EUS-LB), following an initial inconclusive result.

pmc-13627821.title: Secondary actinomycosis in a recurrent odontogenic keratocyst: A clinicopathological diagnostic challenge with 5‐year follow‐up
pmc-13627821.creator: Mohini Kadam, Vidya Lohe, Ravindra Kadu
pmc-13627821.description: OKC is an odontogenic developmental cyst with a significant risk of recurrence. Secondary infections of the lesion with Actinomyces organisms are rare and may pose a dilemma in managing the recurrent lesion. A 20-year-old male patient reported to the outpatient department with a radiolucent multilocular lesion of the posterior right side of the mandible.

pmc-13660639.title: Residential road traffic noise and incidence of depression in Denmark: a nationwide cohort study
pmc-13660639.creator: Anne Marie Kirkegaard, Aslak Harbo Poulsen, Lau Caspar Thygesen, Ole Raaschou-Nielsen, Matthias Ketzel, Steen Solvang Jensen, Mette Sørensen
pmc-13660639.description: SummaryBackgroundEvidence linking transportation noise to depression is limited. We investigated associations between road traffic noise at the most (LdenMax) and least (LdenMin) exposed façades and depression risk in Denmark.MethodsWe established a nationwide cohort of 2,941,456 adults aged 25–65 years and for sensitivity analyses a nested questionnaire-based cohort, the Danish National Health Survey (DNHS, n = 138,987).
